scope: Proposition 8.1 (Polynomial models) of the manuscript “Uniformization of complete Kähler manifolds with positive bisectional curvature” (preprints/Uniformization-of-complete-Kahler-manifolds-with-positive-bisectional-curvature-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 338 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2960f958368ee0ab), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 62. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an integer d ≥ 2 and a macro width 0 < h < 1. After starting at a sufficiently late macro endpoint, there is a grid sk → ∞ with macro endpoints Sj = ehj and the following properties. Each macro interval is either one bad step or is divided into regular steps of length comparable to √ Sj. Thus, eventually, ch √ sk ≤ Δsk := sk+1 − sk ≤ (eh − 1)sk. (8.2) For Fk = Fsk,sk+1 there are polynomial local coordinate changes Hk and polynomial automorphisms Gk of ℂn satisfying Jd(Hk+1 ∘ Fk) = Jd(Gk ∘ Hk). (8.3) The degrees of Hk, Gk, G−1 k are bounded independently of k. The coefficients of Hk and its inverse jet are exp(o(sk)); H′ k(0) and its inverse have polynomial bounds in sk. For a constant Cd depending only on the fixed jet order and dimension, ‖Gk‖coeff + ‖G−1 k ‖coeff ≤ exp ( CdΔsk + o(sk) ) , (8.4) ‖G′ k(0)−1 ‖ ≤ sC k exp(Δsk/2). (8.5) In particular, the coefficient Cd of Δsk is independent of h. Finally, for some finite D, deg G0,k ≤ Dsk on an unbounded subsequence of macro endpoints. (8.6)
